text: This are too big on the bottom to easily pick them up from a hot water bath canner. I purchased these jars at Walmart for canning at a comparable price to Amazon. They look pretty and I am able to use them in the quart-sized section of the [[ASIN:B007QT4GO4 Prepworks by Progressive Reversible Stainless Steel Canning Rack]]. However, what I do not like is that they are too bulbous (round, fat, etc.) on the bottom that it makes them very difficult to pick up from the hot water bath with my [[ASIN:B00FRQVKRY Progressive Ckc-100 One Handed Jar Lifter]]. In fact I find it dangerous because the jars feel like they are going to slip out my grasp. Other than this they are beautiful jars but not ones I will purchase again for water bath canning.
